newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta yield rates up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Malta yield rates up slightly.

text.p: Some short-term yield rates were up slightly in Malta on Monday. The Malta Central Bank said the weekly reverse repo rate was 5.010 percent from 5.009 the previous week.
The weighted average yield on one-month treasury bills was unchanged at 4.996 but up slightly for three months, reaching 5.005 from 4.997 the previous week.
Yield rates for six-month and one-year treasury bills were unchanged at 5.288 (six months) and 5.360 (one year).
The Central Bank discount rate is 5.5 percent.
